terms.title: CDS legal notice, commercial use and citation (restrictive).
terms.text: The CDS notice states: "Any other use, in particular for commercial purposes, without the prior written consent of the CDS is prohibited." It also requires that datasets "must be cited in any work or product that uses them", with the minimum credits "CDS/SIMBAD", "CDS/VizieR" and "CDS/Aladin". Destello's About page does not contain these credit strings. A demo bundle or repository that redistributes CDS-sourced results (SIMBAD identifiers, Sesame resolutions, HiPS tiles) needs those credits placed where they can be read. Any commercial use needs written consent. The citations page could not be read, so the full reference papers remain unverified.

terms.title: CADC terms for NEOSSat (restrictive for a public tool).
terms.text: The CADC home page says its collections "are not intended for general public use". This needs a decision before F-33 uses NEOSSat data in a public product. The terms and conditions page was not reached.

terms.title: Redistribution of derived SPHEREx frames (not verified).
terms.text: No IRSA or DOI page read states whether derived frames may be redistributed, in the demo bundle, in a public repository or elsewhere. The only text found is the acknowledgement and the citation instruction. The rule is not confirmed by any provider page. Action: ask the IRSA helpdesk for the redistribution policy before the demo bundle is published, or keep the bundle free of derived SPHEREx frames until the answer arrives.

terms.title: Gaia attribution in every redistribution.
terms.text: ESA allows free use "provided credit is given to 'ESA/Gaia/DPAC'". Any demo bundle, repository or export that carries Gaia-derived values (overlays, reference stars, validation rows) must keep that credit. The MAST policy itself is not verified.

terms.title: Aladin Lite (LGPL-3.0).
terms.text: A used but unmodified library needs its licence notice kept with the distributed code. Modifications to the library itself would fall under the LGPL. Confirm that the frontend build does not modify the library.
